title: Concept: Go panic with goroutine dump disclosed in a response
description: A response carries a Go goroutine dump. Go prints the full stack of every goroutine on an unrecovered panic, including runtime paths and function arguments, which discloses the module layout, the dependency graph and often credentials or request payloads held in arguments.
applicability: Go HTTP services that let panics reach the response writer.
risk: Full call stack, module paths and argument words disclosed; MEDIUM severity.
